requirements.label: required-courses
requirements.title: Required Courses
requirements.sourceText: The following courses (15 credits) are required of minors: BUS 115 - Introduction to Business 3 credits; COM 120 - Fundamentals of Public Speaking 3 credits; BUS 301 - Business Communications 3 credits; COM 365 - Talking Science 3 credits; COM 351 - Team Collaboration and Community Engagement 3 credits

requirements.label: elective
requirements.title: Elective
requirements.sourceText: One of the following courses (3 credits) is required of minors: BUS 353 - Entrepreneurship 3 credits; BUS 383 - Social Entrepreneurship 3 credits; BUS 399 - Intellectual Property Strategy 3 credits

requirements.label: total-credits
requirements.title: Total Credits

rule.text: Completion of the minor in Communication and Innovation requires 18 credits.
rule.reason: Program-wide total credit requirement; no rule type expresses a total credit minimum for the minor.

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor in Communication and Innovation requires 18 credits.

notes.text: Designed especially for students in STEM fields. Transfer courses will be evaluated individually for Communication and Innovation equivalency by the Undergraduate Director.
